patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase completely (init provider, analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config wiring, install UUID), turns off the sale promo push notifications, and prevents Fyber's crash handler from installing at process start.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Business Calendar 2 Pro by forcing the complete pro status and the force-pro override to return true, routing every feature gate to the full package (7) without touching billing.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all meteoblue Weather premium features by making the billing data source's purchase-state flow always report an active purchase.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Octopi Launcher Pro by returning true from the isPro LiveData getter, bypassing all pro feature gates without modifying billing or database logic.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Wavelet's pro features (Reverberation, Virtualizer, Bass tuner, Equal loudness) by initializing the purchase-verified state flow to true and making the purchase processor always report a verified purchase, which also suppresses the purchase flow.

patches.name: Disable Firebase analytics and remote config
patches.description: No-ops the app's FirebaseAnalytics event logger and the startup RemoteConfig fetch (no FID, no config phone-home).

patches.name: Disable Pairip integrity and license checks
patches.description: Removes the signature-tamper crash and the Play-licensing error dialog and shutdown that fire without Google Play services.

patches.name: Unlock pro features
patches.description: Forces the app's own "purchased" preference on at process start and neutralizes the billing re-verify that erases it without Play services.

patches.name: Adjust animation speed
patches.description: Scales or disables all XML-based animations in Ivy (Quick Panel, drawer, widget and handle animations). Set the scale to 0 to remove animations, or use the disable toggle.

options.description: Multiplier for animation durations. 1.0 = normal, 0.5 = twice as fast, 2.0 = twice as slow, 0 = instant. Applies to all XML animations in res/anim and res/animator.
Instantly finish every XML animation. Equivalent to an animation scale of 0.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables Fabric, Crashlytics, and Answers analytics.

patches.name: Force offline
patches.description: Disables Firebase and RSS network fetches.

patches.name: Remove INTERNET permission
patches.description: Strips the INTERNET permission and disables Ivy's ads, telemetry, Firebase and RSS network paths so the app starts fully offline instead of crashing.

patches.name: Remove Quick Panel transition animation
patches.description: Forces the Quick Panel open and close animations to finish instantly while keeping the animation listeners that set the panel visible.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes AdMob initialization and the quick panel ad view.

patches.name: Disable Bugsnag
patches.description: No-ops Bugsnag on Nova Launcher 8.1.6: both HTTP deliverers return DELIVERED so no payload ever leaves the device (queued error files are deleted as sent), and Nova's error-reporting flag is forced false — which also disables novalytics usage recording. The client still initializes; crash data stays local-only.

patches.name: Disable Sesame integrations
patches.description: Disables Nova Launcher 8.1.6's Sesame third-party integrations (Spotify, OneDrive, Twitch, Slack, Discord, Dropbox, Deezer, GitHub): the integration ingest always returns 0 items, so no background or manual data pulls run and their APIs are never contacted. The Sesame engine and local search indexing continue to work.

patches.name: Disable Sesame search results
patches.description: Removes the bundled Sesame (Branch) deep-shortcut results from Nova Launcher's search on 8.1.6 by no-op'ing its results provider. Search still returns apps, contacts and settings.

patches.name: Unlock Prime
patches.description: Unlocks Nova Launcher Prime on 8.1.6 by forcing the runtime prime flags (Lzg/t1;->y / ->t) to true at every write — the settings initializer and the Prime-unlocker package-change handler.

patches.name: Your Calendar Widget: Remove ads
patches.description: Kills AdMob at every evidenced seam: auto-init provider (attachInfo), overview + settings + promotion-screen banner loaders, the timed promotion popup, and the rewarded-ad bootstrap + display (AdManager load/show). Works independently of the Pro patch.

patches.name: Your Calendar Widget: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks all Pro/task features by forcing the read-side gates (both Utility.isProVersion overloads + Utility.hasTaskAccess). Erosion-safe: purchase state lives in sticky settings that only these gates read; billing failure paths never bypass them. Without GMS, Play Billing can never resolve purchases.
